caption: The image features four rectangular fabric swatches arranged in a roughly square formation on a plain, cream-colored background. The top fabric swatch is a light brown or tan color with a repeating pattern of small blue and white floral shapes. The bottom left swatch has a design of vertical blue stripes and an overlay of a branching, coral-like pattern in beige and rust tones, with some blue accents. The bottom right swatch displays a deep indigo blue background with a repeating motif of small orange and tan flowers connected by thin branches, and white highlights on the petals. The bottom central swatch is also indigo blue and decorated with small orange dots scattered throughout, punctuated by small, simple floral motifs in white, blue, and orange. Beneath these swatches, the name "Erskine R. Carter" is printed in a simple, serif font.
title: Cotton Prints
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
